policy.edge_semantics: These are transfer hypotheses, not canonical prerequisites or proof of competence.
policy.gating: No transfer edge creates an automatic hard prerequisite.
policy.evidence_contract: A transfer claim requires the learner to use the source capability in a distinct target context, explain what changed, identify limits and produce an observable artefact or performance.
policy.approval: Promote only after discipline-owner review and a successful learner task; app owner approval is required before canonical import.

transfers.mechanism: Quantitative modelling supports algorithm analysis, complexity intuition and performance measurement.
transfers.non_equivalence_boundary: A mathematical model is not executable software; implementation constraints and testing remain separate competencies.

transfers.mechanism: Ratios, equations, graphs and measurement uncertainty support circuit prediction and analysis.
transfers.non_equivalence_boundary: Correct algebra does not establish electrical safety or component knowledge.

transfers.mechanism: Probability, statistics and percentage reasoning support risk, inflation and unit-economics analysis.
transfers.non_equivalence_boundary: A numerical model cannot predict markets with certainty or substitute for financial judgement.

transfers.mechanism: Statistics, sampling and uncertainty support research design and interpretation.
transfers.non_equivalence_boundary: Statistical significance does not by itself establish causation, importance or source credibility.

transfers.mechanism: Measurement, rates and basic statistics support training logs and performance analysis.
transfers.non_equivalence_boundary: Performance metrics do not capture all tactical, technical or health dimensions.

transfers.mechanism: Software design and system knowledge support secure development and defensive analysis.
transfers.non_equivalence_boundary: Building software does not confer authorization to test systems; scope and permission are independent gates.

transfers.mechanism: Version control, automation and structured workflows support reproducible work.
transfers.non_equivalence_boundary: Tool proficiency does not guarantee sound prioritisation or operational judgement.

transfers.mechanism: Product engineering enables prototypes and service delivery.

transfers.non_equivalence_boundary: Circuit behaviour also depends on physical components, tolerances and safe setup.

transfers.mechanism: Embedded systems combine hardware, software and constrained computation.

transfers.mechanism: Market discovery benefits from careful sampling and evidence evaluation.

transfers.mechanism: Financial statements and risk analysis use arithmetic, ratios and statistics.

non_transfer_rules.statement: Competence in one discipline never automatically awards competence in another.
A transfer relationship is not a hard prerequisite; hard gates require task necessity and a documented safety or conceptual rationale.
Every transfer claim must name the changed context, constraints, vocabulary and domain-specific knowledge still required.
A polished artefact, high score in a neighbouring discipline or AI explanation cannot substitute for direct evidence of the target capability.
Safety-sensitive transfer is limited to recognition, explanation and supervised practice unless qualified instruction/certification is explicitly required.
